## File: algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/examples/alphaevolve_math_problems/hexagon_packing/12/evaluator.py

Prompts

```
['run the evaluator on a hexagon packing program and return the combined score and eval time', 'verify a hexagon packing construction by checking disjointness and containment of inner hexagons', 'create the six vertices of a regular hexagon given its center, side length, and rotation angle', 'test whether two polygons intersect using the separating axis theorem with configurable tolerance', 'test whether two hexagons are disjoint given their center, side length, and rotation parameters', 'run hexagon_packing_12 to get coordinates for 12 unit hexagons packed inside a larger hexagon', 'build a visualization module that plots the 12 inner hexagons and outer hexagon from hexagon_packing_12 output', 'test hexagon_packing_12 to verify all 12 inner hexagons are disjoint and fit inside the outer hexagon', 'refactor hexagon_packing_12 to accept a parameter n for packing n hexagons instead of hardcoding 12', 'summarize the hexagon_packing_12 function and its return values of inner hexagon positions and outer hexagon side length']
```

Usage

```
{'run_evaluate_hexagon_packing': 'run the evaluator on a hexagon packing program and return the combined score and eval time', 'run_verify_construction': 'verify a hexagon packing construction by checking disjointness and containment of inner hexagons', 'create_hexagon_vertices': 'create the six vertices of a regular hexagon given its center, side length, and rotation angle', 'test_polygons_intersect': 'test whether two polygons intersect using the separating axis theorem with configurable tolerance', 'test_hexagons_are_disjoint': 'test whether two hexagons are disjoint given their center, side length, and rotation parameters'}
```
